subject: Regional allowance & headcount escalation: Senior ML Engineer - APAC candidate
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Regional allowance & headcount escalation: Senior ML Engineer - APAC candidate

Hi Laura / Stephanie —

Quick escalation for an active candidate in APAC (Singapore): Jin Li (resume attached). Sarah from GlobalTech Talent pushed for an offer window that closes Monday. We have a strong technical fit for the Senior ML Engineer role, but market is indicating base-band + regional supplement is needed to convert.

Ask: approval to (a) apply a one-time regional allowance of USD 8,000 on top of the proposed base for this hire, and (b) move the open headcount from "US-based" pool to "APAC remote" for this role (so we can extend market-competitive base). This would be an exception to the current remote banding rules for 2027 — I believe the total offer would remain within the absolute cost we budgeted for the headcount, but the base will exceed the published US-equivalent band by ~7%.

Rationale:
- Candidate countered our initial offer citing cost of living and competing offers in SG/remote APAC.
- Benchmarks: SG market for similar roles is ~10% above our US band midpoint for this level; I attached a quick comp_packet_proposal.xlsx with the benchmarking we used.
- Time pressure: recruiter indicates candidate has other LOIs and expects response by 02/22 EOD.

If you approve the one-time allowance + headcount transfer, HR will generate the offer letter and I can push for sign-off before the window closes. If you prefer to escalate to finance for headcount cap confirmation, please flag asap.

Attachments: jin_li_resume.pdf, comp_packet_proposal.xlsx

Thanks —
Rohan Mehta
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood-inference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Regional allowance & headcount escalation: Senior ML Engineer - APAC candidate

Rohan —

Thanks for the context and the packet. A few clarifying Qs before I sign off:

1) Precedence: Have we made a one-time allowance for APAC hires in the last 12 months at this band? If so, who authorized it?
2) Budget owner: Which department will absorb the incremental base/pay? Please confirm cost center and whether this consumes any runway for other Q1 hires.
3) Permanence: Is this a permanent band adjustment for APAC hires at this level, or explicitly a single-hire exception?
4) Candidate constraints: Is the candidate willing to accept equity tradeoffs if we can’t move base? (i.e., increase RSU vs base).

If this is a single-hire exception and the hiring manager / Eng leadership is covering the delta, I'm likely comfortable approving a one-time regional allowance. If it looks like we need to adjust our APAC banding policy permanently, that needs comp committee and executive review.

Also, please upload the benchmark doc to the HR drive and add the pay rationale template (I can sign once that’s in the system).

Best,
Laura
Head of People Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Regional allowance & headcount escalation: Senior ML Engineer - APAC candidate

On Sat, Feb 20, 2027 at 11:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> Rohan —
> 
> Thanks for the context and the packet. A few clarifying Qs before I sign off:
> 
> 1) Precedence: Have we made a one-time allowance for APAC hires in the last 12 months at this band? If so, who authorized it?

Rohan — quick note from me: I've reviewed the comp packet and the market splits. I'm OK with approving a single-hire exception: one-time regional allowance USD 8,000 + moving the headcount to APAC remote for this role, provided that:

- The hiring manager signs off to cover any delta against their team budget for FY27;
- Laura files the pay rationale and marks this as "one-time exception" in Workday;
- We do not change the published band — this remains an exception and visible only to comp committee.

Vivek, please confirm headcount cap availability on infra-eng S23 budget. If headcount exists and budget owner accepts, authorize HR to issue the offer with the allowance and standard equity package.

If all good, Rohan push the offer ASAP; candidate timing is tight.

-Stephanie
VP, People & Talent | Redwood Inference

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood-inference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Sarah Park <sarah@globaltechtalent.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Regional allowance & headcount escalation: Senior ML Engineer - APAC candidate

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps below. Quoting Stephanie's approval for the record.

Summary:
- Stephanie: approved one-time regional allowance USD 8,000 + transfer headcount to APAC remote (exception only).
- Laura: will upload benchmark and file pay rationale in Workday as "one-time exception".
- Vivek: (cc) please confirm headcount budget; if positive, HR to issue offer.

Action items:
1) Vivek — confirm by 02/23 12:00pm PT if infra-eng S23 has the headcount and accepts the delta against manager budget.
2) Laura — I'll upload the benchmarking doc to the HR drive and attach the pay rationale template; please sign once done.
3) Sarah (recruiter) — stand by to send formal offer letter once HR confirms; target to close by EOD 02/22 the recruiter requested but we are pushing to 02/23 per approvals.

Attached final artifacts: jin_li_resume.pdf, comp_packet_proposal.xlsx, signed-mhra-reference.pdf (reference returned today).

If we get Vivek's go, I'll authorize HR to release offer at: Base USD 146,000 + one-time regional allowance USD 8,000 + standard equity and benefits.

Thanks — we should keep this exception count low; I'll open a thread in comp committee for a larger APAC band conversation for Q2.

Rohan Mehta
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
